# Wall phone voice clips

<!-- Generated by web/scripts/narrate.ts --lines phone; never edit by hand. -->

Each clip is one sentence a caller says on the 1994 desk's wall phone, in that caller's voice (`CAST` in
`web/src/audio/phone/phoneCast.ts`): [Kokoro](https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M) stock voices (hexgrad,
Apache-2.0) or voices cloned from voice samples by [Pocket TTS](https://huggingface.co/kyutai/pocket-tts) (Kyutai,
CC BY 4.0), both running locally, shifted in pitch and speed for the character. Lewis Moten's own voice is not used.
The phone-line sound (a 300 to 3400 Hz band and a little hiss) is added live when a clip plays (`phonePlayer.ts`).
The time and Teddy's pretend bill are spliced from short clips (hours, minutes, seconds; dollars and cents).
`index.json` lists the clips. Words with no clip are spoken by the browser instead.

From `web/`: `npm run voice:phone` records new or changed lines (`-- --only <id>` retakes one);
`npm run voice:phone:check` has Whisper hear them.
